name: github-project-uploader
description: Choose a local project in Codex, run fail-closed checks for likely secrets and Git hazards, then push one exact commit to GitHub after explicit confirmation.

interface.shortDescription: Pick, preflight, and upload local projects to GitHub
interface.longDescription: Choose a registered local project from an interactive Codex card, run bounded heuristic checks for likely credentials, Git-state hazards, and oversized content, then create a new repository or push to an already-matching origin under the currently authenticated personal GitHub account. Repositories are private by default and every upload uses a short-lived, one-time confirmation plan.
defaultPrompt: 选择一个项目上传到 GitHub
把当前项目加入 GitHub 上传列表
对这个项目执行 GitHub 上传预检
